subject.title: Oakland Unified School District Board, District 6

photo.credit: Printed in Alameda County's Voter Information Guide

text: I, ALEXANDRA WILLIAMS, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
1. My name is: Alexandra Williams
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: School Director District 6
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Teacher and Nonprofit STEM Programs Director
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): None

5. Statement of General Qualifications: I’ve taught in district, private, and charter schools for 15 years, and I know what students need to thrive. I’ve seen firsthand what happens when adults fail to do their jobs and what’s possible when schools are safe, supported, and held to high expectations. I’m a proud HBCU graduate, high school math teacher, doctoral candidate in organizational development and leadership, former high school administrator, and nonprofit director of STEM programming. Throughout my career, I’ve built classrooms where students succeed, used data to improve learning, held systems accountable, and made sure resources are focused on students. As your school board member, I’ll ask one question before every decision: Will this move our students forward? If the answer is no, we need a better solution. I’ll bring a much needed perspective, experience, and an unwavering focus on student learning to the school board. Vote Alexandra Williams for Oakland School Board, District 6.

text: I, LEANA POWELL, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
1. My name is: LeAna Powell
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: School Director District 6
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Family Advocate/Community Altruist (2022-present), Council Aide (2022), School & Community Engagement (2022-24)
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): None

5. Statement of General Qualifications: Every Oakland child deserves to attend a school that has great teachers, cultivates a safe and nurturing environment, and welcomes diversity. Yet our schools are losing educators and the support services our children need and deserve, because OUSD has been stumbling from crisis to financial crisis for way too long. OUSD needs responsive leadership to turn things around and that is why I am running for School Board. For five generations, my family has attended Oakland public schools. As a PTA mom, an experienced family engagement specialist, and a community advocate, I’ve spent many years building partnerships with families because I know student success happens when schools and parents work together. My priorities are to ensure that all students are improving their reading and math skills; OUSD finances are balanced and stable; and we authentically engage families in all major decisions with respect, integrity and accountability. #MamaBearForOUSD www.LeAnaForOaklandSchools.com

text: I, VALARIE BACHELOR, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
1. My name is: Valarie LaVerne Bachelor
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: School Director District 6
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Non-Profit Director
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): School Director District 6

5. Statement of General Qualifications: In 2022, you elected me to bring accountable leadership to Oakland public schools. As your School Board Director, I helped keep neighborhood schools open, pushed for stronger budget oversight, and worked to hold district leadership accountable. I also helped advance safer, healthier campuses and protections for immigrant and LGBTQ+ students and families. I came to this country from Bolivia as a child, graduated from public schools, and have spent more than two decades organizing with working families. Strong schools require excellent educators and staff, responsible spending, safe and welcoming campuses, and decisions made with students, families, and school communities. I will continue working for stronger reading and math outcomes, modern facilities, expanded student supports, and stable neighborhood schools where every child can thrive. I respectfully ask for your vote to continue delivering Oakland values and proven results for District 6. Join me at: www.Val4OaklandSchools.com
